question.text: The PMS account opening form captures ALL of the following EXCEPT:

answer.text: Investment approach and portfolio construction choice

explanation.text: The Logic: AOF captures identity, investment profile and IA choice. Political ideology is not collected. The Trap: Basic profile data and IA choice ARE captured. Cross-Exam Context: Similar onboarding form details in X-B. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Any optional questions should be clearly labelled optional to respect investor privacy.
